title: Principal Assistant and Senior Assistant (Re-employment for Retired Employees)
salary_range: Principal of last pay drawn minus amount of pension
summary: District Court, Bhadohi has invited applications for the re-employment of retired employees under administrative office posts. A total of 40 vacancies are available for Principal Assistant and Senior Assistant posts on a temporary contract basis. Eligible retired employees below 65 years of age can submit their applications by 05-12-2026.
eligibility_bullets: Must be a retired employee from judicial services below 65 years of age.
Must submit application along with medical fitness certificate and experience details.
how_to_apply_steps: Download the application format from the official notification PDF.
Fill in all required details, attach self-attested copies of testimonials, last pay certificate, and health certificate.
Submit the completed application form to the administrative office by 05-12-2026 up to 05:00 PM.
